metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Yeah, sure, take it’ and I’m still confused lol
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get handed a kill for free?
Enemy probably ghosted mid-fight.
Click if your aim’s a disaster but the game still flexes you.
Valorant logic strikes again.

Tap if your best kill was a total accident!
